findings.general_parser_issue_pending_root_correc: Original parser does not reject high-bit meta-event type. Standard MIDI Files1.0 printedp7 requires type<128. This does not occur in retained source and does not invalidate run-01.

finding_and_resolution.original: High-bit meta-event types were accepted despite the SMF seven-bit type rule.
finding_and_resolution.resolution: The original source/reports and invalid-acceptance witness are preserved. The sole compiler change rejects meta>=128 before reading its payload. Added tests enumerate all 128 invalid values and retain eight-bit opaque payloads.
finding_and_resolution.scope: No claim that 19 tests prove conformance for every possible SMF; existing fail-closed restrictions remain.

conclusions: All eight raw-derived event streams/text files agree exactly with retained run-01.
The four timing maps and two track merge assumptions remain conditional, with 18 excluded notes, 193 contiguous retriggers, MIDI62 genuine overlap and MIDI51 order-dependent boundary preserved.
Original code paths in first-run receipts resolve by exact SHA to preserved historical source, not to corrected current files.
Stored 19-test and in-memory equivalence receipts are bound; those checks were not rerun by this reviewer.
limitations: No audio or hardware comparison follows from this event-order review.
